title: 10,000 Subscribers
trivia: It is implied that Agent 8 makes the subscriber special cake. In this render, it is hinted by her being inside the food truck.
All Fan Characters featured were participants in the agent z Art Contest, celebrating 10,000 subscribers as well as the moderation team for the agent z VERSUS Discord Server that hosted the event.

Of the 79 total contestants in the agent z Art Contest, 63 submitted their Fan Characters to appear in the render, with there being an additional 3 characters due to the moderators getting one extra Fan Character render each.

Each Fan Character was rendered individually, meaning they also had versions with transparent backgrounds that could be requested by Direct Messaging or pinging agent z asking for their individual Fan Character renders.
Fan Characters could also be drawn by agent z if they were not from the Splatoon universe and lacked 3D models.
The winner of the agent z Art Contest is the one above the rest jumping high with an Ultra Stamp. They were originally meant to feature a small crown hovering over their head, but agent z forgot.
The Finalists of the agent z Art Contest surround Agent Z in a triangle-like format, going from left to right in terms of final placement.

All of the Agents appear in this render. Agent 3 is talking with a Fan Character who had previously helped Agent 8 in finding Agent 3 in Fireworks Festival. Agent X is inside the Octobot King, refernecing the Power Trip Story Arc. Neo Agent 3 is inside of a helicopter, referencing Beach Episode.
All of the Splatoon Idols are featured in this render, albiet in plush form and are hidden across the render.

The render notably takes place in Inkopolis Square, which should've been destroyed as seen in Power Outage. The location was still chosen due to it being one of the most frequently appearing locations in the Splatoon Animation and agent z Classics series.
There are several small items and details spread across the render, referencing several episodes in the Splatoon Animation series, as well as the agent z Classics series.
A racing vehicle was added to the render due to the agent z VERSUS Discord Server having a lot of discussion in regards to racing sports throughout the agent z Art Contest's lifespan.

This render is one of the largest renders agent z has ever made in size, as agent z wanted to ensure that even characters far in the back can still be seen at a high quality when zoomed in. Therefore, the render was made to be 8K in size, or 7680x4320 pixels.
The render was actually too big to fit on the agent z Discord Server due to it exceeding the 10MB limit, being 21MB. Therefore, it had to be compressed as a .webp to reduce it to 7MB.

title: Learning to Drive
trivia: The L plate on the kart is a 'Learner's Plate', a plate required on vehicles for people who have a Learner's Plate and not a full driving license in some countries.
The design of the L plate is specifically based on designs from the Commonwealth of Australia.
This render is one of the first instances of gradients being used in the background to adjust lighting. The render itself was practice for agent z to increase the quality of their renders.
The render references the Mario Kart franchise, with Mario Kart World having its own Nintendo Direct recent to this render.
